Q5137.reason: A qualified physician may testify based on personal examination and medically relied-upon x-rays without introducing the films.

Q5526.reason: The nighttime breaking and entering of the hotel room, a dwelling of another, with intent to commit felony extortion constitutes common-law burglary.
